source: even tempered distribution rho on R
complete_monotonicity: (-1)^k partial_t^k Theta(t)>=0 for every k>=0 and every t>0
bernstein_step: complete monotonicity supplies a positive measure mu on [0,infinity) with the same Laplace transform
injectivity_step: Laplace-transform injectivity for supported tempered distributions gives eta=mu
even_lift: for phi>=0, evenness gives <rho,phi>=<rho,(phi(u)+phi(-u))/2>; the even symmetrization equals psi(u^2) with psi>=0, so <rho,phi>=<eta,psi>>=0
equivalence: rho is positive iff Theta is completely monotone on all t>0
nonfaithful_projections: all derivative signs at only one t0
acceptance_test: Prove global complete monotonicity of the source-derived scalar heat function for every derivative order and every t>0 without zero-location input.
